title: Utillian 8 V2 eRig Wax Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Utillian 8 V2 eRig Wax Vaporizer

The Utillian 8 V2 E rig offers high-quality features at an affordable price. A great choice for those who need a reliable device with extended battery life, customizable temperature settings, and a durable build. Its main feature is the integration of a 3D heating chamber, which efficiently extracts your wax from all sides and the bottom of the chamber. The U8 also comes with convenient, innovative features like a multi-function tool and Boost Mode.

The Utillian 8 also went through a year long update to really perfect the temperature calibrations. Now even better than before, the Utillian 8 V2 is the ultimate budget premium experience for Wax.

Featuring a ceramic and stainless steel BurstHit 3D heating chamber with terp pearls right out of the box. The integrated multi-tool is a feature that allows users to choose between hot and cold loading and prevents the need to carry multiple sticky tools, keeping your device mess-free for longer.

These features combined make the U8 one of the most desirable e rigs on the market.

Utillian 8 V2 Key Features:
– BurstHit 3D Heating Chamber
– Improved Temperature Settings
– New Boost Mode
– 3150mAh Battery
– USB-C Charging
– Multi-Function Tool
– Detachable Device Fabric Cover

About the Utillian 8 V2

BurstHit 3D Heating Chamber: Ensures even heating and efficient vaporization of concentrates.
Improved Temperature Settings: New temp calibrations ranging from 245°C to 330°C for customizable sessions.
Boost Mode: Delivers intense and voluminous vapor for cloud chasers.
3150mAh Battery: Provides longer sessions and efficient power usage, allowing for up to 30 cycles per charge.
USB-C Charging: Allows for faster and more convenient charging.
Multi-Function Tool: Acts as a choke, dab tool, and carb cap, eliminating the need for multiple accessories.
Tinted Glass Bubbler: Reduces splashback and hides debris for more sessions between cleanings.
Detachable Device Fabric Cover: Offers a comfortable grip and customizable look.
Ruby Terp Pearls: Enhance flavor extraction and reduce wax puddles.
Form-Fitting Carrying Case: Provides portability and protection for the device and its components.

Included in the Kit:
Utillian 8 V2 eRig
Utillian 8 Glass Mouthpiece
Built in Multi-Function Tool
Device Cover
BurstHit 3D Heating Element
Carrying Case
5X Cotton Swabs
5X Alcohol Pads
2X Ruby Pearls
